description: This Java source file defines the JobServices class, which provides various static methods for managing background jobs in the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include cancelJob, cancelJobRetries, purgeOldJobs, and resetJob, handling job cancellation, retry management, purging outdated jobs, and resetting job states.

classes.name: JobServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for job management operations such as canceling, retry management, purging old jobs, and resetting jobs within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: cancelJob
methods.description: Cancels a job by setting its cancel timestamp and status, and returns details about the cancellation.

methods.name: cancelJobRetries
methods.description: Resets the maximum retry count for a specific job, with permission checks.

methods.name: purgeOldJobs
methods.description: Removes jobs older than a specified number of days from the job queue.

methods.name: resetJob
methods.description: Resets a job's state to pending, clearing start, finish, and cancel timestamps.
